measures.outcome: Creating local employment opportunities
measures.name: Local people employed or retained
measures.unit_guidance: No. people (FTE) * length of contract (in years) where the maximum number of FTE per person per year is 1.0;
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of local people.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant local people to be employed or retained.

measures.outcome: Creating equal employment opportunities
measures.name: Long-term unemployed people recruited
measures.unit_guidance: No. people FTE (capped at 1 year per employee);
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of a person who can be classified as 'Long-term unemployed'.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant future employees (Long-term unemployed).

measures.outcome: Creating equal employment opportunities
measures.name: Employees recruited who are Not in Education Employment or Training (16-24 y.o.)
measures.unit_guidance: No. people FTE (capped at 1 year per employee);
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of a person who can be classified as 'not in education employment or training' (NEET).
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant future employees (Not in Employment, Education or Training).

measures.outcome: Creating equal employment opportunities
measures.name: Unemployed people recruited
measures.unit_guidance: No. people FTE (capped at 1 year per employee);
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of a person who can be classified as 'unemployed'.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant future employees (unemployed).

measures.outcome: Creating equal employment opportunities
measures.name: Unemployed ex-offenders aged 18 and over recruited
measures.unit_guidance: No. people FTE (capped at 1 year per employee);
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of a person who is an unemployed ex-offender.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant future employees (unemployed ex-offenders aged 18 and over).

measures.outcome: Creating equal employment opportunities
measures.name: Unemployed individuals with disabilities recruited
measures.unit_guidance: No. people FTE (capped at 1 year per employee);
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of a person who is unemployed and who has a disability
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant future employees (unemployed individuals with a disability).

measures.outcome: Providing skills and experience for good work
measures.name: Accredited training for new employees
measures.definition: This Measure covers new employment with accredited vocational training.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of people on relevant vocational training courses.

measures.outcome: Providing skills and experience for good work
measures.name: Employment of new apprentices
measures.definition: This Measure covers the employment of new apprentices at level 2 or higher.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of relevant people (apprentices) to be employed.

measures.outcome: Providing skills and experience for good work
measures.name: Upskilling of existing employees through accredited training
measures.definition: This Measure covers the upskilling of existing employees through accredited vocational training.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of existing employees being upskilled on vocational training courses.

measures.outcome: Providing skills and experience for good work
measures.name: Personalised support to help unemployed people into work
measures.definition: This Measure covers the provision of expert-led personalised support to help unemployed people gain work (not including students).
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of sessions, number of people receiving training and session duration.

measures.outcome: Providing good work opportunities
measures.name: Meaningful unpaid work placements while Not in Employment Education or Training
measures.unit_guidance: No. weeks on placement per person.Working days can be counted pro rata (total  working days divided by 5) but a week has to include at least 3 working days per week.
measures.definition: This Measure covers the provision of unpaid, short-term placements or pre-employment courses that make a meaningful contribution to enabling young people not in employment education or training (NEET) to find gainful employment.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of participants and weeks of work placements or pre-employment courses per person.

measures.outcome: Providing good work opportunities
measures.name: Meaningful paid work placements
measures.unit_guidance: No. weeks on placement per person.Working days can be counted pro rata (total  working days divided by 5) but a week has to include at least 3 working days per week.
measures.definition: This Measure covers the provision of paid work placements that make a meaningful contribution to enabling young people to find gainful employment.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of participants and weeks of paid work placements per person.

measures.outcome: Developing skills and experience for future work
measures.name: Support for students at local educational institutions
measures.definition: This Measure covers staff volunteering with pupils and students of local educational institutions.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of staff hours.

measures.outcome: Developing skills and experience for future work
measures.name: Support for enabling visits of school children or local residents
measures.definition: This Measure covers educational visits to project sites for local school children and residents.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of staff hours.

measures.outcome: Building diverse and sustainable supply chains
measures.name: Spend with VCSEs in the supply chain
measures.unit_guidance: Total amount of £ spent with VCSEs in the supply chain.
measures.definition: This Measure covers spend with Voluntary, Community and Social Enterprises (VCSE) suppliers.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast £ to be spent (not donations) with VCSEs in supply chain.

measures.outcome: Building diverse and sustainable supply chains
measures.name: Spend with local companies in the supply chain
measures.unit_guidance: Total amount of £ spent with the supply chain within the defined local area.

measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast £ to be spent with suppliers in the defined local area.

measures.outcome: Building diverse and sustainable supply chains
measures.name: Spend with local SMEs in the supply chain

measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast £ to be spent with small or medium sized suppliers in the defined local area.

measures.outcome: Promoting a diverse and resilient business community

measures.outcome: Promoting a diverse and resilient business community
measures.name: Support for VCSEs through donations
measures.definition: This Measure covers financial and in-kind contributions to Voluntary, Community and Social Enterprises (VCSEs).
measures.target_guidance: (1) Proposed resources to be donated (e.g., £ donations and/or £ equivalent in-kind contributions).

measures.outcome: Promoting a diverse and resilient business community
measures.name: Support for VCSEs through volunteering
measures.definition: This Measure covers staff volunteering with Voluntary, Community and Social Enterprises (VCSEs).
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of staff hours.

measures.outcome: Building resilient communities
measures.name: Support for local community projects through donations
measures.definition: This Measure covers financial and in-kind contributions to a range of initiatives aimed at improving the welfare and wellbeing of a community.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast resources to be invested.

measures.outcome: Building resilient communities
measures.name: Support for local community projects through volunteering
measures.definition: This Measure covers staff volunteering on local community projects.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast number of staff hours.

measures.outcome: Building community wellbeing
measures.name: Support for community health or wellbeing interventions
measures.unit: £ invested inc. time, materials, equipment etc

measures.outcome: Building community wellbeing
measures.name: Support for initiatives focused on strengthening community networks

measures.outcome: Restoring our climate and improving air quality through decarbonisation
measures.name: Reductions in scope 1 & 2 CO2e emissions through decarbonisation
measures.unit_guidance: Recorded tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) reduced;
measures.definition: This Measure covers the reductions in scope 1 and scope 2 emissions (see Greenhouse Gas Protocol) from decarbonisation initiatives.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Description of the specific decarbonisation initiatives to be undertaken to achieve emission reductions.

measures.outcome: Restoring our climate and improving air quality through decarbonisation

measures.definition: This Measure covers the reductions in scope 3 emissions (see Greenhouse Gas Protocol) from decarbonisation initiatives.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Specific categories to be measured against (see GHG Protocol).

measures.outcome: Restoring our climate and improving air quality through transport
measures.name: Reductions in car miles from a green transport programme
measures.definition: This Measure covers the reductions in car miles driven as a result of a green transport programme.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Description of organisation's green transport programmes to reduce car miles.

measures.outcome: Promoting environmentally sustainable procurement
measures.name: Expert support on carbon reduction to SMEs in the supply chain

measures.definition: This Measure covers the costs associated with the provision of expert-led climate change and carbon reduction training for sub contractors which are Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs).
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast resources to be invested.

measures.outcome: Protecting and restoring biodiversity and ecosystems
measures.name: Support for green spaces, biodiversity or ecosystems
measures.unit: £ invested inc. time, materials, equipment etc
measures.definition: This Measure covers support for a range of greenspace creation and development schemes which preserve or enhance natural land or vegetation.
measures.target_guidance: (1) Forecast resources to be invested.

measures.outcome: Transitioning to a regenerative economy
measures.name: Reductions in plastics used

measures.target_guidance: (1) Description of the initiative to avoid plastic use.

initiative_library.name: Sustainable IT Framework (Phases 1–3)
initiative_library.what: RGESN maturity assessment, Sopht GreenOps platform, baseline dashboards, targeted trainings, scenario analysis, action plan, GDSA case study, monitoring, advisory and communications (deliverables D1–D10).

initiative_library.name: Carbon emissions baselining & supplier-attributed monitoring
initiative_library.what: Scope 1/2/3 baseline at contract start, refreshed each FY; spend-allocated supplier emissions; annual NHS-specific emissions dashboard; independent verification.

initiative_library.name: Net Zero Leadership training
initiative_library.what: Interactive workshops with the Centre for Sustainable Healthcare for board-level NHS leaders.

initiative_library.name: Health & Nature online module
initiative_library.what: 30-minute online module on nature and health for NHS staff.

initiative_library.name: Mandatory Sustainability & Green IT training (Infosys workforce)
initiative_library.what: Mandatory 4-hour training on Infosys Lex for the full contract workforce.

initiative_library.name: CSH Green Space & Health training course
initiative_library.what: Oracle funds NHS staff on Green Health Routes to attend a 6-hour CSH course plus workshops.

initiative_library.name: Data centre efficiency programme
initiative_library.what: PUE 1.3 by Jan 2030; ISO 50001/14001; Climate Neutral Data Centre Pact; 100% renewable data centres.

initiative_library.name: Energy-efficient (green) coding across FWS
initiative_library.what: Developer training on sustainable coding and Green IT awareness for all Infosys developers on the contract.

initiative_library.name: Nudge Programme — Workforce Sustainable Behaviour app
initiative_library.what: Voluntary app nudging NHS staff to cut commuting, travel and paper footprint.

initiative_library.name: Commitment to renewables
initiative_library.what: Partners prioritise renewable electricity; avoid ~150 tCO2e scope 2 per year across 15 years.

initiative_library.name: Supplier emissions transparency
initiative_library.what: Supplier screening and ESG assessments; target 50% cut in scope 2 & 3 supply-chain emissions.

initiative_library.name: IT equipment recovery (Design for Environment)
initiative_library.what: Oracle recovers 100% of data-centre IT equipment, <0.1% to landfill.

initiative_library.name: Social Value Scorecard & Oracle Carbon Calculator
initiative_library.what: Periodic scorecard; OCI carbon calculator tracking 50% of emissions within 5 years.
initiative_library.volume: Scorecard live Y1; calculator from Y3

initiative_library.name: Green Health Routes (5) and Oracle donation
initiative_library.what: Oracle funds and resources five community biodiverse green spaces / NHS green health routes in deprived areas; £85,000 donation.

initiative_library.name: Community Innovation Fund
initiative_library.what: £25,000 every other year across five regions for workforce, wellbeing and sustainability projects.

initiative_library.name: Reforestation donation
initiative_library.what: One-off separately funded reforestation donation.

initiative_library.name: FWS Ambassador Programme (apprenticeships)
initiative_library.what: 80 Level 3/4 apprentices from under-represented / deprived groups providing on-site FWS support; ~10% progress to Level 4.

initiative_library.name: E-Waste Pipeline for prison leavers
initiative_library.what: 11 prison leavers / ex-offenders trained and employed refurbishing devices for the device prescribing programme.

initiative_library.name: Device Prescribing Pilot Programme
initiative_library.what: Primary-care referrals to volunteer digital consultants who prescribe refurbished devices, connectivity and access to the National Digital Inclusion Network.
initiative_library.volume: 500 consultations; 500 devices; 500 connectivity packages; 29,850 hrs digital basics

initiative_library.name: Springboard (NHS-Tech online learning)
initiative_library.what: Certified tech training and learning hours on Infosys Springboard for high-barrier resident / patient groups.

initiative_library.name: Work-Ready Clubs & Maker Zones
initiative_library.what: Weekly after-school clubs for 16–18 year-olds; two Maker Zones in the North West.

initiative_library.name: Springpod virtual work experience
initiative_library.what: Live and pre-recorded virtual work experience for NHS / NHS-tech settings.

initiative_library.name: Tech Returners programme
initiative_library.what: 12-week online reskilling, mentoring and job-placement support for experienced professionals returning after a career break.

initiative_library.name: Young learners in further education (Sutton Trust + MAT)
initiative_library.what: Cash donations and health-tech learning content via Sutton Trust Online and a Multi-Academy Trust; summer schools.

initiative_library.name: Accessibility review
initiative_library.what: Quarterly accessibility review.

initiative_library.name: FWS free of modern slavery (MSAT ≥80%)
initiative_library.what: Bi-annual Home Office MSAT ≥80% (Green RAG); top-3 suppliers complete MSAT; policies, audits, training.

initiative_library.name: Unseen NHS Clinical Modern Slavery Detection training & Learning Academy
initiative_library.what: Infosys funds Unseen (Hope for Justice) to deliver clinical detection training and an awareness academy for NHS staff.

initiative_library.name: Oracle × Unseen e-learning for NHS procurement staff
initiative_library.what: Two additional modules for NHS procurement staff.

initiative_library.name: Community support grant to Unseen
initiative_library.what: Grant supporting Unseen technology initiatives and Infosys–Unseen partnership programmes.

initiative_library.name: Innovation research grant / bursary
initiative_library.what: Research grant / bursary via NHSBSA Student Services.

initiative_library.name: Five modern slavery PhDs

initiative_library.name: PhD implementation fund
initiative_library.what: Fund to implement, test and verify the PhD recommendations.

initiative_library.name: Modern Slavery Awareness Champion
initiative_library.what: Awareness champion and social-scientist support.
